body.zh: 稀释只加入溶剂，溶质的总量不变，所以颜色会变浅但物质的量不变。当浓度低于可见阈值时颜色“消失”——溶质还在，只是稀到看不见了。
body.en: Dilution adds solvent only; the amount of solute is conserved, so color fades but the quantity stays. Below the visibility threshold the color 'disappears' — the solute is still there, just too dilute to see.

misconception.zh: 颜色消失不等于溶质消失。
misconception.en: Color vanishing is not solute vanishing.
